component.name: md
component.summary: Write Markdown and see it rendered

description.p: md is the simplest Markdown editor: write on one side and see the page on the other, or switch to a full-window editor or preview. The same hand-written renderer as md for macOS, iPhone, Android, Windows and VS Code — the same document gives the same page everywhere.
Math with KaTeX and mhchem, Mermaid, Graphviz and PlantUML diagrams and highlighted code are drawn on your computer by the bundled open source engines; plots need no engine at all.

ul.li: Export to PDF at seven page sizes, a self-contained HTML page, EPUB, LaTeX and TextBundle
Writer mode: a book is a folder of chapters and articles, compiled to PDF, EPUB or LaTeX
Continue lists, capitalize sentences, find and replace, a Format menu, Zen mode
Files are saved in place, in the encoding and line endings they came with
